# Navigation stack

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:recipe-navigation-stack` · Kerf UI · production recipe · Recipes

## When to use

A push/pop navigation stack drill-down with animated slides and a live device class.

- A flow drills from a list into detail and back on one pane, at any device size or inside a dialog.

**Not when:**

- Use SplitView when a list and its detail should show together on roomy classes.

## Imports

- Nothing to import: this is a reference composition.
- Declared side effects: lazy-recipe-css.

## Props

No props: this entry has no JavaScript API.
